text: 1、市场早间高开高走，创业板指涨超3%。游戏股大幅走强，大晟文化、电魂网络、巨人网络等涨停。AI漫剧概念走高，芒果超媒、海看股份、掌阅科技等涨停。白酒股延续涨势，皇台酒业2连板，水井坊、金种子酒涨停。大金融股拉升，国金证券、太平洋、恒生电子等涨停。下跌方面，贵金属板块下挫，山金国际跌超6%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4800股飘红，上午半天成交1.15万亿。午间收盘沪指涨1.16%，深成指涨2.39%，创业板涨3.28%。 2、板块概念方面，游戏、AI漫剧、白酒、大金融等板块领涨；贵金属、银行、煤炭、油气等板块逆势下跌； 3、两市共4464只个股上涨，9
text_en: 1. The market opened higher and moved upward in the morning, with the ChiNext Index rising over 3%. Gaming stocks strengthened sharply, with Dasheng Culture, Dianshun Network and Giant Network hitting the daily limit. The AI animated drama concept advanced, with Mango Excellent Media, Haikan Shares and Zhangyue Technology hitting the daily limit. Liquor stocks extended their gains, with Huangtai Liquor posting a second consecutive daily limit and Swellfun and Jindongzi Liquor hitting the daily limit. Major financial stocks rallied, with Sinolink Securities, Pacific Securities and Hundsun Technologies hitting the daily limit. On the downside, the precious metals sector fell, with Shanjin International down over 6%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,800 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the green, and half-day turnover of 1.15 trillion yuan. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.16%, the Shenzhen Component rose 2.39%, and ChiNext rose 3.28%. 2. By sector and concept, gaming, AI animated dramas, liquor and major financials led the gains; precious metals, banking, coal and oil and gas fell against the trend; 3. A total of 4,464 stocks rose across the two markets, 9
